entities.name: Mags
entities.description: A sharp-witted, violent, fiercely independent faerie from Eldraine with black bat-like wings.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A faerie whose coronation Mags reluctantly joined and whom she trapped in a net.

entities.name: Questing Beast
entities.description: Creature that Mags and Rankle once made cry.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where Mags is from.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the Multiverse.

events.summary: During the invasion Mags reluctantly takes part in Rankle's self-proclaimed coronation, crafting a crown from acorns and glass shards.
events.quote: Mags reluctantly participated in Rankle's self-proclaimed coronation

events.summary: Mags traps Rankle in a net, humiliating him, and leads the group in rejecting him.
events.quote: she cunningly traps Rankle in a net

events.summary: Rankle gives Mags an anti-love potion after catching her watching him sleep, following his earlier love potion.
events.quote: he later gave her an anti-love potion after he caught her watching him sleep

relations.quote: Mags led the charge in rejecting him

relations.note: They once made the Questing Beast cry together.
relations.quote: Mags and Rankle once made the Questing Beast cry.
